raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Quark checkpoints may list excluded layers in `quantization_config.exclude` by parameter name (`<module>.weight`). vLLM matches excludes against module names, so those layers are built quantized and their unquantized weights fail to load. This PR maps such entries to module names when `QuarkConfig` is built. Related: #52649 (closed, model-side workaround for a different case).

## Claims

- Fixes loading `amd/Qwen3.8-27B-Quark-AWQ-MXFP4` with `--speculative-config '{"method":"mtp",...}'`. Before, the BF16 MTP head was built as MXFP4 and loading stopped with `AssertionError: self.data.shape == loaded_weight.shape`. With this PR it serves with MTP-3 on vLLM main (MI350P): GSM8K equals main without MTP, and the mean acceptance length is 3.4.
- Exclude entries ending in `.weight` / `.bias` now exclude their module. For fused layers (`qkv_proj`, `gate_up_proj`), the layer is excluded when all its shards are.
- `re:` patterns and entries that already name modules behave as before, and layers that are not excluded are still quantized.
- All three readers of the exclude list see module names: `QuarkConfig.get_quant_method_target`, `get_quark_ocp_mx_group_size`, and the Quark branch of `is_shared_expert_quant_fse_compatible`.

## Validation

**Unit test.** `test_quark_exclude_parameter_names_match_modules` uses an MXFP4 W4A4 config with the checkpoint's exclude format. It fails without the fix and passes with it:

```bash
python -m pytest tests/quantization/test_quark.py -k exclude_parameter_names
```

```
# with this PR
tests/quantization/test_quark.py::test_quark_exclude_parameter_names_match_modules PASSED
# with quark.py from main
E   AssertionError: mtp.fc
E   assert (QuantKey(dty...inearMethod'>) == (None, None, ...inearMethod'>)
E     At index 0 diff: QuantKey(dtype=torch.uint8, ..., group_shape=GroupShape(row=1, col=32)) != None
```

I ran the full `tests/quantization/test_quark.py` with and without the fix, CPU-only. Outside the new test, the results are the same both ways (81 passed / 13 skipped with the fix). The failures and errors in both runs are tests that need a GPU or `torchvision`.

**CI coverage.** The `tests/quantization` Buildkite steps (`:nvidia: Quantization` and its `:amd: (MI300)` mirror) are commented out on main ("Disabled until torchao transitive dependencies are locked"), so this test does not run in CI today. It is pure Python (no GPU, no checkpoint) and runs whenever that step is re-enabled.

**End to end (MI350P, gfx950, TP1), vLLM main.** All arms use the ROCm nightly of main `40941f2c` (2026-11-03, AITER v0.1.27), one GPU, same server flags; "this PR" is that image with only `quark.py` replaced by this branch's (the diff between the two files is exactly this PR's hunk). GSM8K is run the way the [model card](https://huggingface.co/amd/Qwen3.8-27B-Quark-AWQ-MXFP4) reports it: lm-eval `local-completions`, 5-shot, full test set (1319), sampled, in both of the card's modes (thinking: task `gsm8k`, temperature 1.0 / top_p 0.95 / top_k 20, `max_gen_toks` 3072; non-thinking: the card's `gsm8k_nothink` task, temperature 0.7 / top_p 0.8 / top_k 20 / presence_penalty 1.5, `max_gen_toks` 1024).

```bash
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 vllm serve amd/Qwen3.8-27B-Quark-AWQ-MXFP4 \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}' \
  --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN --gdn-prefill-backend aiter_flydsl --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.92 --max-model-len 32768 --max-num-seqs 64 --max-num-batched-tokens 32768 \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching
# the "main, MTP off" arm drops --speculative-config

# thinking (task gsm8k)
lm_eval --model local-completions --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 5 --log_samples --output_path out/think \
  --model_args model=amd/Qwen3.8-27B-Quark-AWQ-MXFP4,base_url=http://localhost:8000/v1/completions,tokenizer=amd/Qwen3.8-27B-Quark-AWQ-MXFP4,num_concurrent=16,tokenized_requests=False,max_length=16384 \
  --gen_kwargs max_gen_toks=3072,temperature=1.0,top_p=0.95,top_k=20,min_p=0.0,presence_penalty=0.0,do_sample=True
# non-thinking (the card's gsm8k_nothink task: the gsm8k prompt ending in "Answer:<think>\n\n</think>\n\n")
lm_eval --model local-completions --tasks gsm8k_nothink --include_path <dir with gsm8k_nothink.yaml> --num_fewshot 5 \
  --log_samples --output_path out/nothink --model_args <as above> \
  --gen_kwargs max_gen_toks=1024,temperature=0.7,top_p=0.80,top_k=20,min_p=0.0,presence_penalty=1.5,do_sample=True
```

| | main, MTP-3 | main, MTP off | **this PR, MTP-3** | model card (MXFP4) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Server starts | no: `AssertionError` in `load_column_parallel_weight` (`mtp.fc`) | yes | **yes** | |
| GSM8K thinking, flexible / strict | – | 0.9219 / 0.9234 | **0.9257 / 0.9333** | 0.9500 / 0.9530 |
| GSM8K non-thinking, flexible / strict | – | 0.8939 / 0.8946 | **0.8999 / 0.8984** | 0.8992 / 0.8976 |
| MTP mean acceptance length (server-side), GSM8K thinking / non-thinking | – | – | **3.43 / 3.41** | |
| MTP mean acceptance length, random 8k in / 1k out, c=4, 32 prompts | – | – | 3.12 | |

<details>
<summary>Traceback on main (MTP-3)</summary>

```
  File ".../vllm/model_executor/models/qwen3_5_mtp.py", line 335, in load_weights
    return loader.load_weights(remap_weight_names(weights))
  File ".../vllm/model_executor/models/utils.py", line 493, in load_weights
    autoloaded_weights = set(self._load_module("", self.module, weights))
  File ".../vllm/model_executor/models/utils.py", line 407, in _load_module
    loaded_params = module_load_weights(weights)
  File ".../vllm/model_executor/models/qwen3_5_mtp.py", line 204, in load_weights
    return loader.load_weights(weights, mapper=self.hf_to_vllm_mapper)
  File ".../vllm/model_executor/models/utils.py", line 358, in _load_param
    weight_loader(param, weight_data)
  File ".../vllm/model_executor/layers/linear.py", line 618, in weight_loader_v2
    param.load_column_parallel_weight(loaded_weight=loaded_weight)
  File ".../vllm/model_executor/parameter.py", line 144, in load_column_parallel_weight
    assert self.data.shape == loaded_weight.shape
AssertionError
```
</details>

- With this PR, accuracy with the BF16 MTP head equals main without MTP (differences within one standard error, ±0.7–0.9 pt), and non-thinking matches the model card's MXFP4 number. Thinking is ≈ 2.5 pt below the card in both main arms alike, so it is not caused by this PR or by MTP. Single sampled run per arm; most of that thinking-mode gap is empty completions (the model emits a stop sequence first at temperature 1.0 on the raw `Answer:` prompt): 32 of 1319 with this PR, 37 with MTP off.
- Acceptance is the server's `SpecDecoding metrics` summed over each eval. For reference, the same evals on v0.32.0 with the same mapping backported gave 3.40 / 3.40, and the same 8k / c=4 case gave 3.16.

## Details

**Root cause.** The checkpoint keeps its MTP head in BF16. It lists the head by parameter name, next to entries that are module names or regexes:

```
"lm_head", "model.visual.blocks.0.attn.qkv", ..., "mtp.fc.weight",
"mtp.layers.0.self_attn.{q,k,v,o}_proj.weight", "mtp.layers.0.mlp.{gate,up,down}_proj.weight", ...
```

`should_ignore_layer` → `find_matching_patterns` → `is_equal_or_regex_match` compares each entry with the layer's module prefix, by exact equality or by `re:` regex. Fused layers are expanded through `packed_modules_mapping`, so `mtp.layers.0.self_attn.qkv_proj` is compared as `q_proj`, `k_proj` and `v_proj`. `mtp.layers.0.self_attn.q_proj.weight` never equals `mtp.layers.0.self_attn.q_proj`, so no MTP layer is excluded and the BF16 tensors do not fit the FP4 parameters.

**Why in `QuarkConfig.__init__`.** Three places read `quant_config["exclude"]` (listed under Claims), so mapping once at construction fixes all of them. It also runs before `apply_vllm_mapper`, so a model's rename mapper sees module names. `QuarkConfig` keeps a shallow copy of the config dict with the mapped list, and the checkpoint's own dict is not modified.

**Why not in the model.** `qwen3_5_mtp.py` already has format-specific workarounds: it forces `mtp.fc` unquantized for `modelopt_fp4`, and it turns off MTP quantization when a GPTQ `dynamic` config has a `-:...mtp...` entry. A third, Quark-specific branch there would fix only this model. Any Quark export that names excluded parameters, whatever the model or layer, has the same problem. The checkpoint already marks these layers as unquantized, so the Quark config should read the entries the way they are written.

**Limitations.**
- Only entries ending in `.weight` or `.bias` that are not `re:` patterns change.
- MoE `check_children` matches by prefix, so it handled `...experts.0.down_proj.weight` before and still does.
- Unchanged: `layer_quant_config` keys, the KV-cache config and online-quantization targets, none of which reads `exclude`.
- Not covered:
  - `DeepseekV4FP8Config.from_config` (V4 and V4.1) copies the raw Quark `exclude` into FP8 `ignored_layers` without building a `QuarkConfig`.
  - `models/inkling/amd/moe.py` checks for fused expert parameter names (`experts.w13_weight`). Those end in `_weight`, so this PR leaves them alone.

**Not a duplicate.** I searched open and closed PRs and issues for `quark exclude`, `quark mtp` and the assertion text, and found no PR that maps parameter-named Quark excludes to modules.
- #52649 (closed) bypassed Quark quantization in `qwen3_5_mtp.py` for MTP heads missing from `exclude`. It was closed in favour of a fix on the Quark side.
- #53248 (open) changes the shared-expert FSE check to use `should_ignore_layer`. It reads the same list, so it benefits from this PR and does not conflict with it.
- #61770 (open) remaps MTP layer indices (`mtp.layers.0` → `mtp.layers.48`) for Qwen4Exp, which is a different problem.

---

Closing: the parameter-named excludes were a one-off manual edit of the checkpoint, not something Quark emits (Quark 0.13 writes module names). The checkpoint is fixed upstream instead: https://huggingface.co/amd/Qwen3.8-27B-Quark-AWQ-MXFP4/discussions/4 (merged as 93245f7c). With it, unmodified vLLM main loads the model with MTP-3 (MI350P: acceptance 3.41, GSM8K non-thinking 0.893 vs 0.894 without MTP).
